notes.title: Now Synced with the Demo!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! We know it's been a while since the last update to the Prologue version. Good news: it's finally here! 🎉[/p][p]The Prologue is now fully synced with the latest Demo build, meaning you can enjoy a bug-free experience with all the improvements we've made recently. Whether you're revisiting or playing for the first time, this is the smoothest version yet.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us and enjoy the ride! 🏁[/p][p][/p][p]Play Full Game NOW![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119780/Drive_Thru_Miami/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Other Games:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354260/TCG_Multiplayer_Card_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
